source_available.instructions: Does state.kernel contain actual source text, rather than only a filename, hash or filesystem path? Judge only the supplied state; you cannot open a local file.

source_marker.instructions: Which private smoke marker is explicitly written in the source text at state.kernel.source? A path is not evidence of file contents. Choose unavailable if the source text is absent.

criteria.unavailable: No source text is supplied or neither marker is present.

source_topology.instructions: Based only on the code in state.kernel.source, what execution structure does fused_conv_sigmoid represent? The fixture is illustrative and was not executed. Select unavailable if source is absent.

criteria.single_kernel: One stage computes convolution and sigmoid together.
criteria.two_serial_kernels: One stage writes an intermediate, then another stage reads it.
criteria.unavailable: The code is absent or insufficient.

history_completeness.instructions: How complete is the iteration evidence in state.iteration_history? Count only records with an optimization direction, implementation change, measured effect, and adoption outcome. The measurements are synthetic test data.
